candidate_input: Unchanged saved final answer only; no candidate reasoning or tool history
incomplete_judge_policy: Preserve the attempt and withhold the final score until all answered cases have valid completed verdicts
model_revision_policy: No dated snapshot is listed by the provider; record requested and returned model IDs, response IDs and timestamps without claiming a pinned snapshot
scope: Existing and future BrowseComp-Plus evaluations in this campaign, for every candidate model and authorized candidate mode
